name: Fairmont Rio de Janeiro Copacabana
positioning: Beachfront Fairmont hotel on Copacabana beach, with 1950s-inspired design and an Amazon-inspired spa
best_for: Travelers who want a base right on Copacabana beach
Guests with dogs or cats, which the hotel welcomes
Travelers who like a hotel-within-a-hotel lounge experience

facts.text: The hotel is located on Copacabana beach in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
The hotel's address is Av. Atlântica 4240, Copacabana.
The rooms combine 1950s style with modern comfort.
The Junior Suite has artwork and furniture designed by designers from the 1950s.
The spa has five massage rooms, including a couples' suite, plus a sauna, beauty salon and a Spa Suite.
The hotel has two swimming pools: an infinity pool and a relax pool.
Dogs and cats up to 25 kilos are welcome at the hotel.
The hotel has a restaurant, a bar and a beach club.
The hotel was formerly a Sofitel.

highlights.text: The infinity pool has a view of Copacabana beach and Sugarloaf Mountain, with daily live music.
The spa's treatments are inspired by Amazonian biodiversity and the beauty of Rio's beaches.
Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience with a lounge offering buffet breakfast and happy hour, 24-hour butler service and an exclusive concierge.
Beach activities include beach tennis, outrigger canoe, stand-up paddle, biking and capoeira.
Curated experiences include the Rio Golden Years Tour, a coffee and chocolate tasting, yoga classes and a drinks masterclass.

considerations.text: Indoor parking is available for an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and prime location.
WhataHotel notes the hotel sits in a busy tourist area with high pedestrian traffic.
